title: Medical Officer and General Physician
organization: Office of Chief Medical Officer, Budaun
age_limit: Not more than 65 years as on notification date
summary: Office of the Chief Medical Officer, Budaun has announced recruitment for 30 contractual positions including Medical Officers and General Physicians under various National Health Mission (NHM) programs for the financial year 2026-27. Interested candidates must submit their applications via registered or speed post by 27th November 2026.
eligibility_bullets: Must hold an MBBS degree or equivalent as required per specific program post, registered with the Medical Council.
Maximum age limit is 65 years as of the notification date.
Relevant professional experience preferred for specific physician/specialist roles.

vacancy_breakdown.category: Telemedicine/Tele Consultation HUB District Hospital Budaun

how_to_apply_steps: Download the application format from the official website budaun.nic.in.
Fill out the application form with required details and attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, caste certificate, registration proof, and experience certificates.
Enclose a self-addressed envelope affixed with a postal stamp of Rs. 55/-.
Send the completed application exclusively via registered or speed post to the Office of the Chief Medical Officer, Budaun, on or before 27-11-2026 by 5:00 PM.
